test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

The wedding preparations are __in full swing__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'at the height of activity'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the idiom*** 'in full swing' **is '**at a stage when the level of activity is at its highest'***
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• The economic recovery is now **in full swing.**
 
 
 
• **Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] Hinglish__**

 
• मुहावरे का अर्थ *'in full swing' *है 'ऐसे चरण में जब गतिविधि का स्तर अपने उच्चतम स्तर पर हो'
 
• आइए एक उदाहरण देखें
 
 
• The economic recovery is now in full swing.
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।
